---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or addition to provedex
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What is the user, operator, or auditor unable to do today? Be concrete.

## Proposed solution

What you want the project to add or change. API sketches and example usage are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you discarded them. If you have not considered alternatives, say so.

## Scope

Is this a change to `provedex-core`, `provedex-cli`, `provedex-server`, the demo frontend, or build/CI? List every component the change touches.
